## 📌 Pull Request Overview

### Type of Change
- [ ] New Skill Added
- [ ] Bug Fix in Existing Skill
- [ ] Documentation / README Update
- [ ] Refactoring / Prompt Optimization

---

## 🎯 Changes Summary
- **Skill Name(s):** `...`
- **Description:** Summary of the changes or new skill added.

---

## 📋 Quality & Compliance Checklist
- [ ] `SKILL.md` contains valid YAML frontmatter (`name` and `description`).
- [ ] Directory name matches the skill `name` in `kebab-case`.
- [ ] Trigger keywords/commands are clearly documented in `description`.
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, personal tokens, or sensitive user paths.
- [ ] [README.md](README.md) catalog table is updated with the new skill (if adding a new skill).
